content.text: Creators in Cameroon face significant barriers when it comes to accepting [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-which-architecture-actually-2|payment]]s for digital products. Conventional platforms like Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or restricted, leaving many unable to monetize their efforts effectively. However, with the right [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-which-architecture-actually-4|COREMERCH guide to crypto]]-payment-gateways-digital-products-5|The Full]], creators can deploy a payment solution that leverages blockchain technology, enabling seamless transactions without traditional banking restrictions. This post outlines the minimum viable stack that can be implemented today, ensuring that digital products can reach international buyers without the roadblocks of conventional payment gateways.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Selling Digital Products from Africa: The Complete Infrastructure Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-step-step-deployment-guide. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

You can launch a fully operational online store today using a combination of free tools. By leveraging Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, you can bypass the traditional banking system. This setup allows you to accept payments in various cryptocurrencies, ensuring that your digital products can be sold globally. Within hours, you can have a functioning storefront, ready to accept orders without the need for Stripe or PayPal.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

Start with the Sovereign Starter Stack, which includes GitHub Pages for hosting and Google Apps Script for your backend logic. This setup allows you to manage three products with ease. For those looking for a more robust solution, the Edge Commerce Stack offers Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, allowing for five products and enhanced functionality. This minimum viable stack ensures that you have complete control over your digital sales and payment processes.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focus on the foundational aspects of your digital commerce stack first. Skip over unnecessary integrations or complex setups that do not directly impact your ability to sell products. Concentrate on establishing your hosting, payment processing, and product delivery framework. Once your basic infrastructure is in place, you can refine and expand your offerings without the initial burden of complicated setups.
Own your infrastructure; don't rent it.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

To get your first transaction live, ensure you have your products uploaded and payment processing configured through NOWPayments. Test the transaction process using a small amount of cryptocurrency, such as USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for minimal fees. Once confirmed, you will have a clear demonstration of your setup's effectiveness, allowing you to confidently market your products and reach international buyers.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, focus on finalizing your product listings and optimizing your store's appearance. Share your store link across social media platforms to drive traffic. Engage with potential customers to generate interest in your digital products. Additionally, consider downloading the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access all blueprints and templates necessary for scaling your digital commerce operations effectively.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Creators in Africa can sell digital products to international buyers by utilizing blockchain-based payment processors like NOWPayments. This allows them to accept cryptocurrencies, thus bypassing traditional payment platforms that may be restricted. By deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack, they can achieve global sales without the limitations imposed by conventional banking systems.
Transact globally without banking restrictions.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and other restricted markets searching for international payment solutions are looking for the same thing: a way to receive USD-equivalent payments from global buyers without a Stripe or PayPal account. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete answer — Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments deployed under your accounts in 48 hours. For creators who want to self-deploy, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 covers both stack options with full source code and step-by-step configuration guides. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Confirm which cryptocurrencies have the best P2P conversion options in your specific country before configuring your payment settings — USDT on Tron is a safe starting point for most African and South Asian markets. Create your NOWPayments account and add wallet addresses for your primary coins. Set up a P2P exchange account — Binance P2P is available in most restricted markets and supports local currency pairs. Deploy your chosen stack: Stack 01 via the Sovereign Blueprint or Stack 02 via the Edge Commerce Stack deployment. Configure the NOWPayments IPN webhook URL in your account settings pointing to your backend endpoint. Run a complete mainnet test transaction and confirm the pipeline end-to-end before promoting. Complete a test P2P conversion with a small amount so you know the process before your first real sale.
